column2: Complete all REQUIRED fields. Delete rows 1-3 before loading. Supplier_ID must be unique. Validate with: python workday_financial_validator.py supplier_master this_file.csv 3
Supplier_Category valid values: Vendor | Contractor | Consultant | Employee | Intercompany | Government | Non_Profit | Individual
Tax_ID_Type valid values: EIN | SSN | FEIN | Foreign | None
Default_Currency: 3-letter ISO code. This is the default — invoices can still be in other currencies
Payment_Terms: Must match a valid Workday Payment Terms Reference ID in your tenant (e.g. Net30 / Net45 / Due_Upon_Receipt)
Default_Payment_Type valid values: ACH | Check | Wire | Virtual_Card | Manual | Intercompany
Country: 2-letter ISO country code (US / GB / CA / DE / FR etc.)
Inactive: TRUE only for suppliers being brought in as inactive (historical). Leave FALSE for all active suppliers
Load order: Object 3 — load after Cost Centers, before Open AP Invoices and Open POs
